unsupported.fact: CA->>CA: sig ... then CA->>CA: body ... (likewise DA, TR, VA, MO: sig message always before body message)
unsupported.why: Sequenced self-messages claim the sig value is produced before the body value for every kind; the original draws sig and body as unordered siblings in each subgraph, and for traits the code interleaves them (trait_hashes, collect.rs:616-650 feeds sig and body per member in one loop).
